introHtml: Beacon ice scrapers are built for heavy-duty winter use, with rugged handles and sharp blades that cut through frost quickly. When you order custom Beacon ice scrapers from Perfect Imprints, you can add your logo via pad printing or screen printing to keep your brand visible during snowy commutes. These scrapers are a practical giveaway for safety managers or HR directors looking to equip employees with reliable winter gear. Choose from compact 7-inch models or longer 10-inch scrapers for trucks and SUVs.
